svg.title: Native deployment
svg.desc: Interactive conceptual flow. Tab to a node or control and press Enter or Space; arrows change the step. A static image shows the same labeled path.

text.tspan: locked dependencies and the chosen profile

svg.text: Click a node, or Tab + Enter.
Arrow keys step through the main path.
Cyan: application / execution · Violet: persistence / proof · Rose: failure outcome
Conceptual path; detailed implementation and evidence limits are in the guide.
